about_the_game:
What is "Love Starts Again"?

A live-action romance adventure with high-definition images that unfold from the protagonist's perspective.

As you become the protagonist and make choices to change the future, you will become embroiled in dramatic romances with the heroines. A realistic romance simulation filled with situations that everyone dreams of experiencing at least once.

A story of carving out the future with six heroines

◆Story

The setting is Tokyo. Working at a black company.
One day, he collapses from overwork.
When he wakes up, he's in the room he lived in in the past.
As he tries to change the future,
he gets caught up in a dramatic love affair.

◆ Heroines

Azusa: #Friend #Cheerful #Honest #ESFJ

Kasumi: #Childhood friend #Unrequited love #Jealousy #ENFP

Yuki: #Junior #Lady #Innocent #INTP

Ai: #Senior #Part-time job #Trust #ISFP

Chitose: #Favourite #Influencer #Cunning #ESFP

Miku: #??? #Mysterious woman #Shy #INFJ

Features

◆A real love adventure in 4K from the protagonist's point of view

All scenes were shot in 4K from the protagonist's point of view.
It has a sense of speed like a short drama, but also contains memorable scenes. Here is a real love experience in Tokyo.

◆Various choices and multiple endings

As Shakespeare's work states, "Life is a series of choices," you will be forced to make choices that seem like everyday choices. A single response can change the future...
Not only that, but a variety of choices will unfold that can lead to humor, seriousness, horror, suspense, and mysterious endings.

◆A thorough commitment to realism

A scenario that seems like it could happen on the edge of reality, where everyone has thought, "I want to go back to those days..." and fantasies. Communication through chat and short videos. We've stuck to realism to create a sense of immersion.

When you see the ending with the heroine, you will surely think:
"Love starts again."
